notes.title: UPDATE V1.014 - INFINITE MODE
notes.notes:
# [b] UNLIMITED ZOMBIE WAVE MODE [/b] [code][list][b]UPDATE V1.014[/b][*] User requested infinite mode has now been added to the game. [/list][/code]

To enable the mode just hit the checkbox next to the infinite mode text on the arcade machine. 

Hope you like it!

Please do not hesitate to contact me directly with any feedback or suggestions. I will do my best to include them in future updates.

notes.title: HOTFIX UPDATE V1.012
notes.notes:
# [b] UPDATED THE GAME BASED ON USER REVIEWS AND SUGGESTIONS. [/b]
[code][list][b]UPDATE V1.012[/b][*] Added controller mapping hints [*] Pistol Zombie now has unique sounds to distinguish player shots from zombie shots. [*] Throwing axe will now damage and move exploding barrel [*] Axe throwing zombie can no longer throw axe directly after spawning [*] The grenade has been temporarily removed due to reported issues. My apologies for the inconvenience. I will be adding new weapons to compensate shortly. Stay tuned. [/list][/code]
Please do not hesitate to contact me directly with any feedback or suggestions. I will do my best to include them in future updates.

notes.title: HOTFIX UPDATE V1.01
notes.notes:
# [b] UPDATED THE GAME BASED ON USER REVIEWS AND SUGGESTIONS. [/b]
[code][list][b]UPDATE V1.01[/b][*] Fixed a bug which allowed the shotgun to be fired with the slide back.[*] Rearranged the boxing wave to a later round.     [*] Adjusted the throwing axe angle. [*] Improved the dual wielding reloading mechanics. [*] Holstered weapons will now remember the 'state' you holstered it in, after you pick it back up. [/list][/code]
Please do not hesitate to contact me directly with any issues or suggestions. I will do my best to include them in future updates.
